what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Angola in the Republic of the Congo: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 54 Angolan asylum seekers in the Republic of the Congo, 0.3% of all asylum seekers from Angola.
Refugees from Angola, a separate group, live mostly in France, Canada, Germany and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Angola with UNITA from 1998 to 2002.
It also records armed conflict over Cabinda territory in periods from 1997 to 2025, most recently with FLEC-FAC-TN.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 89, at the end of 2014; the main years of displacement in the data are 2010 and 2013 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Republic of the Congo.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the Republic of the Congo only.
